items.title: Treasury Proposes Rules Defining Who Can Legally Sell Stablecoins in US
items.summary: Exchanges and other crypto platforms would face new restrictions on selling stablecoins to US customers beginning in 2027.

items.title: Wall Street Pushback Halts SEC's Crypto Fundraising Framework, Sources Say
items.summary: The securities regulator cited an "unforeseen scheduling issue," but sources point to a legal threat from Wall Street trade group SIFMA and an administration waiting to see whether the Clarity Act passes in September.

items.title: U.S. Treasury Department proposes GENIUS Act stablecoin rule
